description: This file defines the Subunit class within the OrangeHRM project, extending FilterField and implementing ValueXNormalizable and ValueXModifiable interfaces. It provides methods for filtering employee data based on organizational subunits, extracting subunit IDs, and modifying or normalizing subunit-related data for reporting purposes.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Represents a report filter field for organizational subunits, allowing filtering, normalization, and modification of subunit data in Employee reports.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filtering condition to the query builder based on selected subunit IDs and operator.

methods.name: getSubunitIds
methods.description: Extracts and returns an array of subunit IDs from the 'x' parameter.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in query expression, in this case 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Normalizes the 'x' value into an array with subunit id and name, for report display.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Converts the subunit 'x' value into a chain representation for display or further processing.
